title: Project Phantom
description: A simple light weight modpack for Project Phantom Season 0
body:
QOL Modpack for Project Phantom SMP
Enhance your experience on the Project Phantom SMP with our official Quality of Life (QOL) Modpack! Designed specifically for our community, this carefully curated collection brings together essential mods that improve gameplay comfort, visuals, communication, and performance without altering the core vanilla feel of the server.
Key Features Include:

Voice Chat (VC): Built-in proximity voice chat for immersive, real-time communication with fellow players. Coordinate builds, explore caves, or simply chat while adventuring together — no more typing in chat during intense moments!

Stunning Shader Support: Compatible with popular shader packs to transform Minecraft’s graphics. Enjoy dynamic lighting, realistic water, beautiful skies, and atmospheric effects that make the Phantom world truly breathtaking.

Performance Optimizations: A robust selection of performance mods (Sodium, Iris, Lithium, Starlight, and more) significantly boosts FPS, reduces lag, and ensures smooth gameplay even during large events or busy base areas.


Whether you’re a builder, explorer, or redstoner, this modpack makes Project Phantom SMP more enjoyable and accessible. Lightweight yet powerful, it runs efficiently on most setups while preserving the integrity of our survival multiplayer experience.
